methodology: Fresh canister per mode and trial; identical frozen Wasm and canonical ACVP case 4 inputs. Four disposable 32 MiB allocations and 24 explicit GC-trigger updates per retained and dropped stage; every step has a query snapshot. Queries verify all roots against the external signature before/after retention collection and after dropping. Tail statistics use the last eight GC snapshots. Heap occupancy includes garbage and collector copies; allocation minus reclamation is not exact live memory. The arithmetic residual heap-(allocation-reclaimed) is called evacuationCopiesBytes here, not independently measured object liveness. A stage qualifies only with at least 64 MiB reclaimed, tail heap spread <=4096 bytes, and zero residual copies in all eight samples. These observations do not prove that GC finished or that measured bytes are exact live bytes. Matched-trial baseline subtraction isolates observed prepared-cache occupancy; unqualified windows remain raw evidence requiring investigation. Wasm capacity and maximum observed post-GC heap are high-water statistics and need not decrease after drop.
